# Canadian Reindeer PrioScout Report (Round 2)

![](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQ17T5GtEiY8l0gX_l8AvlgKL54z92lDOwV9A&s){width="100%"}

```{r Initialize, echo=FALSE, eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
calcs <- read.csv("data/calculations.csv", check.names = FALSE) %>%
  filter(`Random IDs` %in% 117:228)

results <- read.csv("data/results.csv", check.names = FALSE) %>%
  select(
    c("Sample IDs", "Random IDs", "crossed", "thres_pos", 
      "MPR_pvalue", "MS_pvalue", "AUC_pvalue", "Result")
  ) %>%
  mutate_at("Random IDs", as.integer) %>%
  filter(`Random IDs` %in% 117:228)

sample_number <- nrow(filter(results, !(`Sample IDs` %in% c("N", "P"))))
positives <- results %>%
  filter(Result == "Detected" & `Sample IDs` != "P")
suspects <- results %>%
  filter(Result == "Suspect")
```

## Methodology

Swab pellets were re-suspended in 500μL of 0.1% SDS/1X PBS. Samples were run by RT-QuIC in 4 replicates for 72 hours at 42°C. Results were compared against the negative plate controls using a t-test with the alternative hypothesis being that a sample will have a larger value than the negative control. Metrics analyzed were maxpoint ratio (MPR), maximum slope (MS), and area under the curve (AUC). The p-values for each metric must have been ≤ 0.05 and at least 50% of replicates must have crossed a threshold of 3 times the background fluorescence for a sample to have been considered "detected". If a sample had at least 50% of its replicates cross the threshold, but was negative for any of the other three metrics, it was labelled as "suspect".

\newpage

## Swab Results
Positive sample IDs: **`{r} paste(positives[["Random IDs"]], sep = ", ")`**; Suspect sample IDs: **`{r} paste(suspects[["Random IDs"]], sep = ", ")`**

```{r pos-fig, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-cap: "Positive or suspect samples. Samples are identified by the blinded 'Random ID' provided by the collection team. A: The rates of amyloid formation for the positive samples. B: The real-time graphs."

samples <- bind_rows(positives, suspects)
data <- read.csv("data/data.csv", check.names = FALSE) %>%
  filter(`Sample IDs` %in% samples$`Sample IDs`) %>%
  left_join(results, by=c("Sample IDs"))

rt_fig <- data %>%
  ggplot(aes(Time, Norm, group=Wells, color=Result)) +
  stat_smooth(formula=y ~ s(x, k=30), method="gam", se=FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-0.1, 72.1), breaks=seq(0, 72, 6), expand=FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#99023B", "#5F5589")) +
  facet_grid(rows=vars(`Random IDs`)) +
  labs(
    y = "Normalized RFU",
    x = "Time (h)"
  ) +
  main_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle=0, hjust=0.5, vjust=1),
  )

box_fig <- calcs %>%
  filter(`Sample IDs` %in% samples$`Sample IDs`) %>%
  left_join(results, by=c("Sample IDs", "Random IDs")) %>%
  mutate_at("Random IDs", as.factor) %>%
  mutate(Result = factor(Result, levels=c("Not Detected", "Suspect", "Detected"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    `Random IDs`,
    RAF, 
    fill = Result
  )) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#5F5589", "#99023B")) +
  labs(
    x = "Random IDs",
    y = "Rate of Amyloid Formation (1/s)"
  ) +
  main_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle=0, hjust=0.5, vjust=1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

ggarrange(box_fig, rt_fig, ncol=2, widths=c(1, 3), labels=c("A", "B"), font.label = list(size=20), common.legend = TRUE)
```

```{r Boxplot, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-cap: "Rates of amyloid formation (RAF) of each sample. A larger RAF indicates a higher prion load in the sample."

calcs %>%
  left_join(results, by=c("Sample IDs", "Random IDs")) %>%
  mutate_at("Random IDs", as.factor) %>%
  mutate(Result = factor(Result, levels=c("Not Detected", "Suspect", "Detected"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    `Random IDs`,
    RAF, 
    fill = Result
  )) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#08D2FF", "#5F5589", "#99023B")) +
  # facetted_pos_scales(y = y_scales) +
  labs(
    x = "Random IDs",
    y = "Rate of Amyloid Formation (1/s)"
  ) +
  main_theme
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
#| label: tbl-results
background_list <- list(
  "Detected" = "#99023B",
  "Suspect" = "#5F5589",
  "Not Detected" = ifelse(knitr::is_html_output(), "none", "white")
)

text_list = list(
  "Detected" = "white",
  "Suspect" = "white",
  "Not Detected" = "black"
)

results %>%
  rename_all(~ str_replace(., "_", " ")) %>%
  mutate_all(
    ~ cell_spec(
      .,
      background = background_list[Result],
      color = text_list[Result]
    )
  ) %>%
  kable(
    booktabs = TRUE,
    longtable = TRUE,
    linesep = "",
    format = ifelse(knitr::is_html_output(), "html", "latex"),
    escape = FALSE,
    align = "c",
    caption = "Results table of RT-QuIC testing. 'crossed': fraction of replicates above threshold; 'thres pos': at least half of replicates crossed threshold?; MPR: maxpoint ratio; MS: max slope; AUC: area under the curve."
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("hold_position", "repeat_header")
  )
```
